oxygen.note: patch notes 2025-11-16 (knowledge #4641-4644): levels 2 and beyond are underwater; there players lose oxygen over time, leaving to level 1 or out of the dungeon refills it fully; 10 minutes under without a refill = Minor Oxygen Deprivation: -5 hits (unpreventable) every 5 s while above 66 %, each follower -5 % of its hits while above 66 %; 20 minutes = Major: -10 / -10 % while above 33 %. Recovery Dolphins at the entrances to level 3 and the boss rooms refill it every 5 s (#4645): not placed (not seen). Live (capture): on level 2 the server sent the 'Oxygen' gump 0xEC5F8754 every 6 s (11:08:37-11:14:05), its second bar's art 28135 stepping down one every 30 s (28125 at 11:13:14, 10 steps in 4.5 min [INFERENCE: 20 steps = the 10 minutes]), back to 28135 on level 1 at 11:13:39 (the refill); no deprivation reached. underwater: level 2's box (flood fill)
